# Ezydrag

> Ezydrag is an AI agent studio in India. We design, build and run AI agents for revenue teams (sales, marketing and RevOps), inside the tools they already use: CRM (Salesforce, HubSpot, Attio), marketing automation (Marketo, HubSpot), data (Snowflake, BigQuery, Databricks), workflows (n8n, MCP servers, APIs) and Slack, Microsoft 365 or Google Workspace. A person on the client's team approves every important step.

Key facts:
- Model: a service, not software. We build, run and improve the agents.
- Flagship: Sales Nurture Agent (capture, enrich, score, nurture, meeting, won).
- Portfolio: Email Creation Agent, Email QA Agent, QBR Generator, AI PTA, Voice Agent (with Nutaan AI), Ask Ezydrag, Prospecting Agent, Governance Agent.
- Built to order: Speed-to-Lead, Churn and Upsell, Deal Follow-up, CRM Cleanup, Forecasting, Deal Desk, Attribution agents.
- Agents never negotiate prices and never send important messages without approval.
- Legal name: Ezydrag Private Limited. Offices: Kolkata, Bangalore, Durgapur. Contact: hello@ezydrag.in

## Field Notes (blog)

- [n8n AI Assistant: why asking first matters - Ezydrag](https://ezydrag.in/blog-n8n-assistant-asks-first.html): n8n's AI Assistant builds, tests and fixes workflows from plain English, then asks before publishing. Why that confirm button matters more than the AI.
- [Designing approval for AI agents - Ezydrag](https://ezydrag.in/blog-approval-is-not-a-button.html): How to design the approval moment for AI agents: what the reviewer sees, when they see it and what happens if nobody answers. From Ezydrag's design lead.
- [MCP 2026-07-28 spec: what stateless means for you - Ezydrag](https://ezydrag.in/blog-mcp-goes-stateless.html): The Model Context Protocol's 28 July 2026 spec dropped sessions for stateless requests. What changed, why it matters for business agents, what to do next.
- [Chaos engineering for AI agents: a founder's guide - Ezydrag](https://ezydrag.in/blog-break-your-agent-on-purpose.html): AgentChaos showed agent success can drop 50 points when APIs misbehave. How to chaos-test business agents before launch, from Ezydrag's leadership.
- [AI agent costs: credits, meters and budgets - Ezydrag](https://ezydrag.in/blog-your-ai-bill-gets-a-meter.html): Atlassian meters Rovo credits from 3 December 2026 and n8n bills AI in credits. How founders should budget AI agents per outcome, from Ezydrag.
- [Agent harness engineering, explained simply - Ezydrag](https://ezydrag.in/blog-agent-equals-model-plus-harness.html): What an agent harness is (tools, context, memory, checks) and why it decides reliability more than the model does. A plain-English guide.
- [Workflow vs AI agent: when to use which - Ezydrag](https://ezydrag.in/blog-workflow-or-agent.html): n8n Agents made the choice explicit: fixed workflows or goal-driven agents. A simple test for founders, with four quick sales and marketing examples.
- [AI SDR agents after Dreamforce 2026: what wins - Ezydrag](https://ezydrag.in/blog-every-crm-has-an-sdr-agent.html): After Dreamforce 2026, agents that nurture and qualify inbound leads come built into the CRM. What still sets a sales team apart, from Ezydrag's leadership.
- [The labor illusion: designing trust for AI agents - Ezydrag](https://ezydrag.in/blog-labor-illusion-ai-agents.html): Why people value services more when they can see the work: the labor illusion, operational transparency and response-time limits, applied to AI agent design.
